suffix: Only spoken voice, natural room tone, no music, no subtitles, no text on screen. Realistic lip sync.

grandma_floor.scene: Handheld smartphone home video filmed by a family member at night in the bedroom. The 72-year-old woman on all fours on the parquet floor pushes herself up in one quick agile movement and stands upright facing the camera, grinning proudly, barefoot. The grey-haired man at the left edge laughs warmly. Natural body proportions, no distortion.
grandma_floor.voice: No speech. Only soft warm laughter from the man and natural room tone.

grandma.scene: Handheld smartphone home video filmed by a family member at night in the bedroom, slight natural shake. The 72-year-old woman stands facing the camera and talks directly to it, beaming with pride and joy, lively expressive face, small hand gestures at chest height, a thumbs-up near the end. The grey-haired man at the left edge smiles and stays in the background, silent.
grandma.voice: Her voice: elderly French woman aged 72, native French, warm, cheerful, slightly frail but energetic, amused and proud, natural pace.
